title: Land Cruiser 300 Series
eyebrow: TOYOTA LAND CRUISER · J300 · 2021–PRESENT · NOT SOLD IN THE US
verdict: This is the Land Cruiser the rest of the world gets and America has to admire from a distance. It's lighter, stiffer and quicker than the 200, and its engineers used a 30-year-old 80 Series as the benchmark. The only way to buy one in the US is with a Lexus badge on the front.

paragraphs: Toyota unveiled the J300 on 9 June 2021 to replace the [[land-cruiser/200-series|200 Series]], which had been on sale since 2007. The V8s are gone. In their place is a pair of twin-turbo V6s: a 409-hp 3.4-liter petrol and a 304-hp 3.3-liter diesel. The truck rides on a new body-on-frame platform and weighs about 200 kg less than the 200. It went on sale in the UAE and Kuwait within weeks, then Japan, Australia, South Africa and much of Asia. It has never been sold in the US or Canada. Wikipedia cites slow sales of the 200 and limited production capacity. North America gets the truck as the [[lexus/lx600|LX 600]] instead.

story.heading: BENCHMARKING THE 80
paragraphs: Chief engineer Takami Yokoo made an unusual choice for a flagship launch: he compared the new truck to a 30-year-old one. 'We actually used the Land Cruiser 80 as a guidepost,' he told reporters, adding that 'even 30 years after it first appeared, it has the best rough road performance of any Land Cruiser.' The team kept the wheelbase that started with the [[land-cruiser/80-series|80 Series]], and Yokoo summed up the brief as being 'the partner that will get you home safely, no matter where you go.'

To find what needed fixing, Toyota drove the outgoing 200 around Australia. The trip showed that drivers got tired, so the engineers changed the suspension geometry to make it smoother on pavement. Laser welding that joins two types of metal increased torsional rigidity and helped take out about 200 kg (440 lb). The engine sits lower and further back, and a V6 replaces the V8, so the nose is lighter. Dakar Rally driver Akira Miura did test driving and reported much better control and balance.

story.heading: WHAT'S UNDER IT
paragraphs: The platform is GA-F, which the [[land-cruiser/250-series|250 Series]] and the Lexus GX later shared. Most markets get the V35A-FTS 3.4-liter twin-turbo petrol V6 (VJA300) or the F33A-FTV 3.3-liter twin-turbo diesel (FJA300), both with a 10-speed automatic. Some markets also keep the old 4.0-liter 1GR-FE V6 with a six-speed (GRJ300). The chassis gets an upgraded Electronic Kinetic Dynamic Suspension System (E-KDSS), adaptive variable suspension, Multi-Terrain Select with new Deep Snow and Auto modes, and an underbody camera.

For the first time there's a GR Sport. Auto Bild described it as inspired by the Dakar Rally, and it is the version to have off-road: it has front and rear locking differentials, while the standard truck has only a center lock. Ground clearance is 230 mm and the approach angle is 32 degrees, and overall length, width and wheelbase are largely the same as the 200's. ANCAP's 2022 rating scored it 89 percent for adult occupants and 88 percent for children.

story.heading: THE WAITING GAME
paragraphs: Demand overwhelmed supply. In January 2022 Auto Bild reported that Toyota's Japanese website was telling buyers to expect waits of up to four years, a backlog it compared to the Mercedes G-Class's. Germany wasn't expected to get the 300 at all, and kept the older J150 Prado instead. A hybrid, the VJH300, arrived in 2025, launching first in the UAE with a new front end. Wikipedia records a partial update for Japan, with a hybrid due there on 1 October 2026.

story.heading: THE AMERICAN WORKAROUND
paragraphs: For Americans, importing a 300 isn't a realistic option, because of the 25-year rule; one IH8MUD member worked out that 2047 is the first year a 2022 truck becomes legal. The practical answer is the [[lexus/lx600|LX 600]], unveiled on 13 October 2021 on the same platform with the 409-hp V35A and a 10-speed. The 457-hp LX 700h hybrid followed, and the LX 700h Overtrail, announced in October 2024, has front, center and rear lockers like a GR Sport.

Being the US version has a downside: the US recalls. NHTSA campaigns 24V381 and 25V767 cover V35A engines in the Lexus LX, Tundra and some GX 550s in which machining debris can damage the main bearings, causing knocking, rough running or a stall. 25V767 alone lists 9,895 LX models built between February 2022 and April 2024. Separately, Lexus is updating transmission software on about 4,400 2025–26 LX 600s. The sources here don't say whether overseas 300s with the same engine are covered, so owners outside the US should check with their local Toyota distributor.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · THE 300 YOU CAN BUY HERE
callout.title: LX 600 and LX 700h: a Land Cruiser with a Lexus badge
paragraphs: Mechanically, the [[lexus/lx600|LX 600]] is the 300 Series with a Lexus body and interior: same GA-F frame, same 3.4-liter twin-turbo V6 (409 hp, 650 Nm), same 10-speed. Lexus adds trims Toyota doesn't offer, including an F Sport, a four-seat Ultra Luxury and, since late 2024, the LX 700h Overtrail with three lockers. Wikipedia counts about 7,000 US LX sales a year since 2023.

Many of the owners in IH8MUD's 300-series section drive LXs, and they've taken it on the trail with Slee skid plates and sliders, 35-inch tires, and even 74Weld portal axles. If you live in North America and want a 300, this is how you get one.

engineering_intro: The 300 keeps the formula that made the name: a separate ladder frame, full-time four-wheel drive with low range, and stabilizer bars that are hydraulically linked by E-KDSS. Toyota rebuilt everything around that formula. The frame is lighter and stiffer, the twin-turbo V6 sits lower and further back, and there's a 10-speed automatic, adaptive dampers and a camera that shows what's under the truck.

engineering.note: Redesigned to be lighter and more rigid; length, width and wheelbase are largely the same as the 200's.

engineering.v: About 200 kg (440 lb) lighter than the 200
engineering.note: Laser welding of mixed metals; Toyota also claims a lower center of gravity and better weight distribution.

engineering.v: 3.4 L twin-turbo petrol V6 · 3.3 L twin-turbo diesel V6
engineering.note: V35A-FTS: 409 hp / 650 Nm. F33A-FTV: 304 hp / 700 Nm. Some markets keep the 4.0 L 1GR-FE.
Upgraded hydraulic stabilizer-disconnect system for articulation; Multi-Terrain Select with Deep Snow and Auto modes.

engineering.v: Center lock standard; front + rear on GR Sport
engineering.note: 230 mm ground clearance, 32° approach, up to 26.5° departure.

generations_table.note: 10-speed auto. Wikipedia lists the figures from 2022.
Carried-over naturally aspirated V6 with a 6-speed auto, for some markets.
Debuted in the UAE with a redesigned front end; Japan launch planned for 1 October 2026.
First GR Sport Land Cruiser: front and rear lockers, extra body adhesive, about 5 mm shorter.

generations_table.note: The North American 300. LX 700h Overtrail has three lockers.

buying_checks.head: Accept that it's an LX in the US
buying_checks.body: The 300 isn't sold in the US or Canada and can't be legally imported under the 25-year rule for a long time. For North American buyers, the LX 600 or LX 700h is the 300 Series you can actually buy.

buying_checks.head: Run the VIN against the V35A recalls
buying_checks.body: NHTSA campaigns 24V381 and 25V767 cover V35A engines in which machining debris can damage the main bearings, causing knocking, rough running, a no-start or a stall. 25V767 lists 2022–2024 LX models built from February 2022 to April 2024. Ask whether the engine has already been replaced, which several IH8MUD members' trucks have had.

buying_checks.head: Check the transmission software recall
buying_checks.body: About 4,400 2025–26 LX 600s are being recalled for transmission-control software that can let the transmission damage itself. Dealers reflash it for free.

buying_checks.head: Test-drive in traffic, not just on the highway
buying_checks.body: Owners of 2022–24 LX 600s describe a clunk into first gear and hesitation when accelerating from a rolling stop. Some blame the pre-collision system intervening. Drive one through a few stop-and-go junctions before you buy. Owners say the LX 700h hybrid doesn't do it.

buying_checks.head: Work the rear hatch
buying_checks.body: One IH8MUD owner's power hatch beeped and refused to close. The cause was a sticking left-side pinch sensor, which was replaced. Open and close it several times.

buying_checks.head: AHC or not, and which locker count?
buying_checks.body: Many LX trims have height-adjustable AHC suspension, and armor is specific to it: Slee sells separate non-AHC LX 600 sliders, for example. Overtrail and GR Sport trucks have front and rear lockers; standard trucks have only the center lock. Know which one you're buying.

buying_checks.head: Ask about fluid changes
buying_checks.body: Owners on IH8MUD do early differential and transfer-case changes (around 20,000–30,000 miles) after reports of debris in Tundra differential oil. Records of early oil and gear-oil changes, or oil-analysis reports, are a good sign.

repairs.title: Transfer case and front diff fluid service
repairs.symptoms: Scheduled service. One IH8MUD owner also reported less low-speed 'rocking' in traffic after changing the transfer-case fluid at 19,500 miles.
repairs.fix: Remove the skid plate (two bolts to loosen, per one owner). Always remove the fill plug first, then drain and refill. Figures an owner posted from the service data: transfer case 1.89 qt, plugs 37 N·m (27 ft-lb); front diff 1.23 qt, plugs 39.2 N·m (29 ft-lb); rear diff (with limited-slip) plugs 49 N·m (36 ft-lb). The factory transfer-case fluid is Toyota LF 75W. While the skid is off, grease the driveshaft zerks.
repairs.tools: Socket set · torque wrench · fluid pump · Toyota LF 75W (transfer) and the specified gear oil · new washers: copper for the front drain, flat for the transfer case, collapsible for the front fill and rear drain/fill (as identified by an owner) · grease gun.

repairs.title: Early oil change and oil analysis
repairs.cost: Oil, filter and a lab kit
repairs.symptoms: A new or new-to-you V35A truck, especially one built before the recall fixes.
repairs.fix: Many owners change the factory fill early, around 1,000 miles, and send a sample to a lab such as Blackstone. One owner found heavy machining debris in a 2024 GX's oil at 800 miles and much less in a December 2024-build LX at 1,000 miles. Others report high iron and copper at the first change that settled to normal by the third. Repeat the analysis every few changes and keep the reports.
repairs.tools: Socket set · filter wrench · 0W-20 oil (owners report running 0W-20; check your manual) · oil-analysis kit.

repairs.title: ATF drain-and-fill
repairs.cost: Fluid (one owner estimated about 12 qt for a full exchange)
repairs.symptoms: Rough or erratic shifts on a truck with 'lifetime' fluid, or towing and hard off-road use.
repairs.fix: The 10-speed uses thin Toyota WS fluid and has a strainer, not a serviceable filter. An IH8MUD member argues that the lifetime-fill recommendation lets wear metals build up in the valve body. Owners do a drain-and-fill or a staged exchange with WS or a WS-compatible fluid, then set the level with the factory temperature-based check procedure. If you don't have the procedure and a scan tool to read fluid temperature, have a shop do it.
repairs.tools: Socket set · fluid pump · scan tool (Techstream or similar) to read ATF temperature · Toyota WS or a WS-compatible fluid · service manual.

parts.name: OEM oil pan & strainer diagram (drain/check plugs, gaskets)

repairs.title: Rear hatch won't close
repairs.symptoms: You press the hatch button, it beeps once as if it's going to close, then beeps twice and doesn't move.
repairs.fix: First, clean the rubber pinch strips along both sides of the hatch opening and check nothing is caught in them. On the IH8MUD owner's truck the left-side pinch sensor was sticking, and replacing it fixed the problem. Under warranty, let the dealer do it.
repairs.tools: Trim tools · replacement pinch sensor (left or right as diagnosed).

parts.name: OEM back door diagram — 'Sensor Assy, Power Back Door' LH/RH (pinch sensors)

repairs.title: Driver's-side windshield rattle
repairs.symptoms: A rattle at the bottom corner of the windshield.
repairs.fix: Two owners traced it to leaves trapped under the hood near the hinge and in the well where the wiper linkage connects. Open the hood, vacuum out the debris, and fit a strip of foam to keep leaves from getting back in.

repairs.title: Tame rolling-stop hesitation
repairs.symptoms: Delayed or missing throttle response, or a clunk into first, when accelerating from a rolling stop. Owners say it's worse in Sport and Sport+ modes.
repairs.fix: As an interim fix until Lexus updates the software, owners set the pre-collision system (PCS) to its minimum distance using the screen in front of the driver; turning PCS off also works but loses a safety system. Some use Carista to keep the PCS setting across restarts (and to quiet the ventilated-seat fans). Make sure any software recall is done first.
repairs.tools: None, or an OBD-II dongle with Carista.

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: IH8MUD owners report 275/70R18 (about 33.3 inches) and 285/70R18 KO3s (about 33.7 inches) with no rubbing on stock suspension. One LX owner with 275/70R18s had no rub at any AHC height, at full lock, in drive or reverse. 295/70R18s on stock wheels have been reported on an LX 700h Overtrail, and Dissent Off-Road told a member that 35s on a +40 mm offset wheel fit with minimal to zero trimming.

faq.q: Can I buy a 300 Series in the US?
faq.a: Not new. It isn't sold in the US or Canada, and the 25-year import rule rules out bringing one in for decades. The Lexus LX 600 and LX 700h are the same truck under the skin and are sold in North America.

faq.q: Why didn't Toyota sell it in America?
faq.a: Wikipedia cites slow sales of the 200 Series and limited production capacity. The smaller 250 took over the Land Cruiser name in the US for 2024.

It depends on the market: a 3.4-liter twin-turbo petrol V6 (409 hp), a 3.3-liter twin-turbo diesel V6 (304 hp), a carried-over 4.0-liter V6 in some places, and since 2025 a 457-hp V6 hybrid. All but the 4.0 use a 10-speed automatic.

Every 300 has a lockable center differential. The GR Sport adds front and rear lockers. On the Lexus side, the LX 700h Overtrail has all three, and Wikipedia also lists a Japan-only LX 'Offroad' trim with three.

faq.q: How much lighter is it than the 200?
faq.a: About 200 kg (440 lb), thanks to the redesigned GA-F frame and laser-welded mixed-metal construction. The V6s are also lighter than the V8s they replaced and sit further back.

The US LX 600 shares the V35A with the Tundra, and both are covered by recalls 24V381 and 25V767 for machining debris that can ruin the main bearings. Later engines were built with improved processes or an improved main bearing, and some are still under investigation. Owners routinely do early oil changes and oil analysis.

faq.q: What did Toyota use as the benchmark?
faq.a: The 80 Series. Chief engineer Takami Yokoo said the 80 still had 'the best rough road performance of any Land Cruiser,' and the 300 keeps the wheelbase the 80 introduced.

faq.q: How long was the waiting list?
faq.a: In January 2022 Auto Bild reported Toyota Japan quoting waits of up to four years for new orders.
ANCAP's 2022 rating, aligned with Euro NCAP, scored 89% for adult occupants, 88% for child occupants, 81% for vulnerable road users and 77% for safety assist.

faq.q: What fluids and capacities does it take?
faq.a: From service data posted by an IH8MUD owner: transfer case 1.89 qt of Toyota LF 75W, front diff 1.23 qt. Owners also report using 0W-20 engine oil. Check your own service manual, since markets and drivetrains differ.

mods.why: Skids and rock sliders are the first job on any 300 or LX that leaves the pavement. Make sure sliders match your suspension (AHC or not).
A winch bumper gives you a winch mount, and aftermarket recovery points give you rated places to attach a strap.
The extreme route to 37s: portal hubs lift the truck without touching the suspension geometry. IH8MUD has several LX builds on portals, and Slee runs one.
Standard 300s and LX 600s have only a center lock. Adding front and rear lockers matches a GR Sport or LX 700h Overtrail.
Owners pull the third row and fit drawers and a fridge slide for overland trips.

baseline_service.intro: Toyota never sold the 300 in the US, so the specs below are for its US twin, the Lexus LX 600 (same V35A-FTS twin-turbo V6 and 10-speed). They come from AMSOIL's LX 600 lookup and service-data figures posted by IH8MUD owners. Diesel (F33A-FTV) and hybrid trucks differ, and service intervals vary by market, so check your owner's manual. Baselining matters more than usual here because of the V35A machining-debris recall.

items.spec: SAE 0W-20 · ≈7.7 qt with filter · drain plug 30 ft-lb, new plug and gasket
items.interval: At purchase, then per your market's schedule [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]. Many owners shorten it and send samples for oil analysis.
items.note: On a US LX 600, check that engine recall 25LA07/25LB07 has been done. Repeat oil analysis every few changes and keep the reports.

items.spec: OE-type panel filter · interval [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.interval: At purchase; more often in dust

items.spec: OE-type iridium plugs (V35A) · interval [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.note: It's a twin-turbo engine, so don't assume a 120k plug interval.

parts.name: OEM ignition coil & spark plug diagram

items.spec: Toyota Super Long Life Coolant or equivalent · ≈11.7 qt
items.interval: Inspect at purchase; replacement [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]

items.spec: Toyota Genuine ATF WS · ≈12.2 qt total fill
items.interval: Toyota calls it lifetime fill. Owners drain-and-fill or do a staged exchange at 20,000–30,000 mi.
items.note: There's a strainer, not a serviceable filter, and no dipstick. The level is set at a specified ATF temperature, read with a scan tool, through the check plug. One LX 700h owner got about 5 qt out of the pan. On a 2025–26 LX 600, check that the transmission recall has been done.

items.spec: Toyota Genuine Transfer Gear Oil LF 75W · 1.89 qt · plugs 37 N·m (27 ft-lb)
items.note: Remove the fill plug first. The plug washers are flat, not crush washers. Removing the skid plate means loosening two bolts.

items.spec: 75W-85 GL-5 (Toyota LT) · front 1.23 qt, plugs 39.2 N·m (29 ft-lb) · rear with LSD 5.55 qt, plugs 49 N·m (36 ft-lb)
items.interval: At purchase; change the front about twice as often as the rear
items.note: The front holds just over 1 qt and comes out dirtier. Trucks with a limited-slip rear need LSD-rated oil (one F Sport carries an 'LSD only' tag). Washers: copper on the front drain, crush-type on the front fill and on the rear drain and fill.

items.spec: Chassis grease at every zerk (about four)
items.interval: Whenever the skid plate is off
items.note: An owner found the front zerks hard to reach (frame and exhaust in the way). One took three pumps before grease showed at the seals.

items.spec: Sealed hydraulic systems · fluid [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]
items.note: Check the cylinders, lines and accumulators for weeping. Lexus trucks with AHC: make sure every height mode works.

items.interval: Flush at purchase if the history is unknown
